source_metadata.question: Sohom constructs a square $BERK$ of side length $10$. Darlnim adds points $T$, $O$, $W$, and $N$, which are the midpoints of $\overline{BE}$, $\overline{ER}$, $\overline{RK}$, and $\overline{KB}$, respectively. Lastly, Sylvia constructs square $CALI$ whose edges contain the vertices of $BERK$, such that $\overline{CA}$ is parallel to $\overline{BO}$. Compute  the area of $CALI$.\n<image1>

target.reason: On both sides matching transverse ticks group segments that have equal lengths within that diagram. A single-tick group and a double-tick group use the same equality convention; this does not assert equal numerical lengths between the two separate problems.
